data.title: FinOps Data Engineer
data.description:
*About the Role*

We're looking for a FinOps Data Engineer to help drive cost optimization and cloud financial governance across our AWS infrastructure and GCP footprint. You'll work cross-functionally with Engineering, Finance, and Product to find and ship savings, build the tooling necessary to maximize efficiency of every dollar spent in the cloud, and cultivate a culture of cost awareness across engineering teams. This role owns the data side of that mission: the models, pipelines, and analysis that make cost, usage, and margin numbers trustworthy across the company.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not an analyst seat. You'll do the schlep work other teams don't have time for, ...

enrichment.summary: A hands-on FinOps Data Engineer at Supabase who builds and maintains the data side of cloud cost management: BigQuery/dbt pipelines and models over AWS and GCP billing/usage data, cost-vs-revenue and unit-economics marts, forecasting and anomaly detection, and automated cost governance — working cross-functionally with Engineering and Finance to find and ship savings.
enrichment.timezone_note: Fully remote, global hiring; the team operates asynchronously with flexible hours.
